score.scope: Fixed models on independently sealed ITU observations. Participant bootstrap is conditional on this enriched sample; no multiplicity adjustment, model retraining variability or unseen-site guarantee.

uncertainty_display_clarification.legacy_text_scope: The fixed UniBa explanatory string only; external calculations group all25 ITU observation IDs.
